trust_decision.summary: MISMATCH: the advisory is about writing SessionToken/SecretAccessKey to debug logs, but the listed fix commit (#2822) changes peer bucket-metadata reload after lifecycle put/delete and touches no logging of secrets. The pinned tree already redacts STS credentials (Credentials Debug masks secret_key/session_token; the AssumeRole debug log emits only access_key/parent_user/expiration).

landing_point.why: The summary names SessionToken and SecretAccessKey in debug-mode logs. The AssumeRole handler is where those values are generated and logged, and that site is already redacted at the pinned commit.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the residual tier-credential debug logs: 'the advisory is about STS SessionToken/SecretAccessKey, and remote-tier backend credentials are a different feature'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Debug logs keep access_key, parent_user and expiration for troubleshooting, and only secret_key/session_token are masked. An over-broad fix that drops the whole log or masks access_key loses legitimate diagnostics.

O7_producer.where: Derived Debug on TierCreds/TierS3 decides what tier debug logs print (crates/ecstore/src/tier/tier_admin.rs:23-29, crates/ecstore/src/tier/tier_config.rs:316-324), but no published fix site exists to compare against.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin add-tier handler debug-logs the full tier config; derived Debug on TierS3 includes secret_key in clear text.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are remote-tier backend credentials, not STS SessionToken/SecretAccessKey.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Same crate as the landing point (rustfs/src/admin/handlers); struct is in the crates/ecstore package.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin edit-tier handler debug-logs TierCreds; derived Debug includes secret_key and creds_json.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above: a neighbouring feature, not STS.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Same file as the add-tier route; struct is in crates/ecstore/src/tier/tier_admin.rs:25.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Revert the manual masked Debug to a derived Debug, so every {:?} of Credentials leaks secret_key/session_token (a how-type producer the log call never names).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The struct derives everything else; a maintainer could easily add #[derive(Debug)] and drop the manual impl.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A structured debug! field that adds session_token next to access_key.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring fields are logged the same way, so this looks like routine troubleshooting.

O10_build.project_tests: unknown for logging; the fix adds one unit test in crates/ecstore/src/notification_sys.rs (fix.diff:67-83), unrelated to the advisory
